preserved_choices: All v1.2.1 model, gains, disturbance, reserves, solver and recovery choices unchanged

screen.q_sample_rule: center then all 128 lexicographic sign corners; deterministic, no random selection
screen.continuous_box_enclosure: NOT_ESTABLISHED; nodes are numerical point checks only
screen.complete_qp_estimate_rule: zero plus all 128 corners of [-dbar-varpi(0),+dbar+varpi(0)]; no disturbance truth
screen.complete_qp_policy: Evaluate only after both pair families pass at prescribed q. Do not adjust duration on a QP failure.

preparation.holding_policy_proposed: project_torque_box(SlotineLi(q_ref=q_mid, qd_ref=0, qdd_ref=0, dhat), tau_max); DOB uses actually applied saturated torque
preparation.end_state_rule: Measured q,qd within declared neighborhood; never assert exact midpoint/zero. Recheck full rows on measured state.
preparation.duration_rule: Analytic common-Ko exponential threshold over the fixed q sample set for BOTH pair families; round UP to control-period grid and add one period when settling is required; no trial/post-hoc retuning

reference_proposal.initial_rule: measured P1 endpoint q,qd; qdd_ref(0)=0 proposed

observer_proposal.method: coupled continuous z,q,qd RK4 with held applied torque
observer_proposal.discrete_observer_sensitivity: separate sampled update sensitivity, not a physical sampled-observer certificate
observer_proposal.signed_preparation_clock_execution_suppo: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; existing state/epoch contracts require review before prehold execution

failure_semantics.hard_qp_infeasibility: A2_FAIL_NO_ADVANCE_NO_TORQUE_IN_DEVELOPMENT; not a hardware-safe zero torque claim
